SddAmplifyNfr.keywords: nfr, amplify, budgets, latency, throughput, scale, availability, consistency, bottlenecks, degradation, sdd-amplify-nfr
SddAmplifyNfr.Mission:
Turn the empty Non-Functional Constraints header of a scope spec into quantitative budgets: latency / throughput / scale / availability / consistency as numbers, plus named bottlenecks and behavior under overload. Loaded lazily by the discovery interview's triage when the scope carries load, growth, or availability expectations; inherits the session core — not repeated here.
Input — the scope spec draft + interview context (usage profile signals). Output — a filled `Non-Functional Constraints` subsection (`NFR_BUDGETS_FORMAT`) + follow-up items on the discovery interview map. Out of scope: benchmark methodology, load-test tooling — those are execution-time concerns.

BeliefState.Axiom: An amplification opens with a ready answer, not a questionnaire. FIRST assemble a complete defaults package — the decisions live products of this class actually ship with (run a short targeted research pass when class practice is uncertain, grounded in the scope's intent) — and present it as ONE accept-or-edit reply: the operator takes everything with one word or edits by item number. Ask via the AskUserQuestion / multi-question tool when available; fallback `QUESTION_FORMAT`. Deep-dive questions open only for topics the operator explicitly marks deep-dive; every untouched topic keeps its default. An accepted default is a real decision — record it like one.

Every non-trivial decision → a Decision Log entry in `DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT` (D-NNN, Status, Recorded, Why in the operator's wording, Risk accepted, Rejected alternatives; IDs are stable). Which decisions qualify and which Decision Log receives the entry are specified per directive.

A non-functional constraint is a number plus its measurement condition: latency as a percentile under stated load (`p95 ≤ 200ms @ 100 RPS`), availability as a target with an error budget, scale as concrete volumes (rows, RPS, concurrent users, growth horizon), consistency as a named model. «Fast», «reliable», «scales» are placeholders, not constraints — replace each with a measurable budget, or record an explicit «не бюджетируем, потому что …» decision.
Последовательный `await` независимых задач складывает их задержки (Latency). Параллельный запуск сводит общую задержку к самой медленной задаче.
Чтение данных быстрее, чем их может обработать потребитель, накапливает бесконечный буфер в RAM. Игнорирование Backpressure — это прямой путь к OOM на устройствах с 4-8 GB памяти.

SddAmplifyNfr.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_USAGE_SIGNAL` | Neither the spec draft nor the operator gives any scale / load signal to budget against — return the question to the interview | | `H_OPERATOR_REJECTS_DEFAULTS` | Operator declines the whole defaults package and skips deep-dive — leave the spec untouched |

Step.Goal: Assemble the numeric budget package for this product class.
Step.Action: Extract the usage profile from the spec draft (who calls what, how often, how much data). Per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST`, draft a default budget per dimension — latency, throughput, scale + growth horizon, availability, consistency — with numbers live products of this class actually hold (per `AX_BUDGETS_ARE_NUMBERS`; short targeted research when class practice is uncertain). Name the expected first bottleneck and the degradation posture under overload (shed / queue / reject — mind `AX_BACKPRESSURE_IS_LAW`, `AX_LATENCY_STACKING`). No usage signal at all → `H_NO_USAGE_SIGNAL`.

Step.Goal: One accept-or-edit gate; deep-dive only on explicit pick.
Step.Action: Present the budget table as ONE reply per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST` (AskUserQuestion when available, else `QUESTION_FORMAT`); each dimension accept / edit / deep-dive. Deep-dive topic map: load profile → latency budget → scale horizon → availability + error budget → consistency → bottlenecks → degradation. A dimension the operator consciously skips gets an explicit «не бюджетируем, потому что …» row. STOP.

Step.Goal: Write the agreed budgets into the spec.
Step.Action: `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/nfr-budgets-format.xml")` and fill the `Non-Functional Constraints` subsection of the scope spec. Non-default picks and notable accepted defaults → Decision Log per `AX_DECISION_LOG_REQUIRED`. Budgets that need validation against reality → items on the discovery interview map. Return control to the interview.

SddAmplifyNfr.ChatOutput: Service line — dim, internal, never narrated (`AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`): `📐 AMP_NFR · dims= · accepted= · edited= · dive=`.
